metadata.description: Get USPS retail postage prices for a square greeting-card envelope weighing 2 oz, mailed from ZIP code 98101 to ZIP code 10001

common_info.email_credentials: credentials to use the assigned disposable email account
common_info.user_info: alex_green_personal_info.json; the dummy user's personal information
common_info.user_resume: PDF resume with disposable email account injected

instruction: Open https://postcalc.usps.com/. Get USPS retail postage prices for a square greeting-card envelope weighing 2 oz, mailed from ZIP code 98101 to ZIP code 10001. It is a letter, not a postcard or large envelope, and its square shape matters for the price, so describe it as a square envelope. The outcome is the request for the list of mail services and prices; buying postage is not required.
